name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: small plugins that add to its screen and behavior

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, toggled with /context-bar

plugins.name: ghostty
plugins.description: Ghostty integration: a 4-word summary as the tab title (/title for a new one now), a tab progress bar, ❓ and a notification when Claude waits on you, /goto between Claude sessions (waiting ones first), /workspace to save and reopen windows of sessions, and /keybind for Ghostty keys that type into Claude

plugins.name: rate-limits
plugins.description: 5-hour and weekly rate-limit gauges above the prompt, with a warning at 90%

plugins.name: say
plugins.description: Claude Code speaks through murmur (Kokoro on the Apple Neural Engine): turn summaries, needs-you alerts, background tasks, progress check-ins and rate-limit warnings, each session in its own voice (/say picks one)

plugins.name: session-id
plugins.description: Shows the session id in the prompt footer; click to copy

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: A one-line TL;DR under Claude's long replies, written by Claude Haiku; the say mod speaks the same line

plugins.name: turn-receipt
plugins.description: A receipt row above the prompt after each turn: time, tools, files edited, cost
